tagline: Learn at your own pace, with your teacher beside you
testBanner: TEST SITE: all data here is made up

common.teachersOnly: This page is for teachers only.
common.offline: No internet connection. Your answers so far are saved; you can continue when you're connected.
common.somethingWrong: Something went wrong while loading this page.

auth.signInFailed: Signing in didn't work. Please try again.

chrome.message: Evolora works in Google Chrome. Please open this page in Chrome.

home.nothingYet: Nothing to do in this class yet.
home.joinExplain: Type the class code your teacher gave you.
home.todoEmpty: Nothing to do right now. Well done!

joinResult.closed: {{className}} is closed to new students. Ask your teacher.
joinResult.checkCode: Check the code: one of the characters seems to be wrong.
joinResult.noClass: No class has this code. Check it with your teacher.
joinResult.wait: Too many wrong codes. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes, then try again.
joinResult.failed: Something went wrong, and you didn't join. Please try again.

teacher.noClasses: You don't have any classes yet.
teacher.subject: Subject
teacher.noStudents: No students have joined this class yet.
teacher.classNotYours: This class doesn't exist, or you don't teach it.
teacher.newCodeConfirm: Make a new code? The old code will stop working. Students already in the class stay in it.
teacher.joiningOpen: Joining is on: students can join with the code.
teacher.joiningClosed: Joining is off: the code doesn't work.
teacher.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the class? They won't see the class any more. Their work is kept.
teacher.removedExplain: Their work is kept. They can join again with the class code while joining is on.
teacher.wholeClass: The whole class (also students who join later)
teacher.givenDone: Given. The students see it on their pages.
teacher.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
teacher.openEarlyExplain: A lesson from a course, opened now for the students you choose, whatever comes before it. Good for students who are ahead.
teacher.openedDone: Opened. The students see it as open.

lesson.question: Question
lesson.tipsLink: I didn't understand… show me a tip
lesson.notAllowed: This lesson isn't open to you.
lesson.end: You've reached the end of the lesson.
lesson.videoBlocked: This video can't be played inside the lesson.
lesson.locked: This lesson is still locked. It opens when you finish the lesson before it.

test.switchExplain: Test site only: sign in as a made-up test user with one click.
test.switchFailed: Switching didn't work. The test users may need to be set up again.

q.tryAgain: Not quite. Here's a hint, then try once more:
q.checkAgainExplain: One more question like it, to make sure it's clear now.
q.teacherTold: Your teacher was told, and will go over this question with you.
q.savedForTeacher: Your answer is saved. Your teacher will check it.
q.testScorePending: Open answers still wait for the teacher.

problem.notNumber: Please type a number, for example 12.5 (no letters). This didn't use up an attempt.
problem.offline: No internet connection: your answer wasn't sent. Try again when you're connected.
problem.failed: Something went wrong, and your answer wasn't sent. Please try again.

status.lockedExplain: Opens when you finish the lesson before it.

cls.notInClass: This class or course doesn't exist, or you're not in it.

follow.statusExplain: Red: an open red flag. Behind: more than 1 lesson behind the middle of the class in a course. Late: past a due date (due dates come later). OK: everything else. A star: ahead of the class. Not done counts as 0 in the average; answers waiting for you are left out.
follow.flagCheckAgain: two wrong answers to the check-again question (question {{question}})
follow.flagMinimum: ran out of practice questions before reaching the minimum (topic: {{topic}})
follow.clearNote: Note (optional), for example: talked with them, understands now
follow.studentNotHere: This student is not in the class.
follow.gradesExplain: Click a lesson to see each student's answers. Not done counts as 0 in the average; answers waiting for you show "to grade".
follow.nothingToGrade: No open answers to grade in this lesson yet.
follow.keysHint: Keyboard: Alt + arrows. Sideways: same question, another student. Up and down: another question.
follow.scoreLabel: Grade, 0 to 100 percent of the question's marks
follow.todoEmpty: Nothing waiting for you right now.
